svg.title: OBSERV-E: Autonomous Perception / Assistive Robotics
svg.desc: OBSERV-E. Human-following perception and spoken guidance for visually impaired users. Won the StarkHacks 2026 Qualcomm Robotics Track. YOLO11 person detection, single-target lock, and tracking with an OpenCV / Lucas–Kanade optical-flow fallback A constant-velocity Kalman filter projects the gimbal target state at 100–300 Hz, decoupled from inference rate On-device hazard detection, an optional asynchronous VLM scene narrator, and speech that fires only when something changes
